title: 带负载的 RC 低通电路
statement: RC 低通电路的输出端接有负载 R₂：R₁ = 2 kΩ，C = 0.5 µF，R₂ = 2 kΩ。网络函数 H(jω) = U_o/U_s。
电源角频率 ω = 2000 rad/s。求此时的 |H(jω)| 和 H(jω) 的相位，并确定这个电路的截止频率。

questions.ask: 这个电路的截止频率 f_c = ?（ω_c = 2πf_c）
questions.explain: 从电容两端看进去的等效电阻是 R₁∥R₂ = 1 kΩ，ω_c = 1/(R_eqC) = 2000 rad/s，f_c = ω_c/(2π) ≈ 318.3 Hz。在 ω_c 处 |H| = 0.3536 正好是低频值 0.5 的 1/√2（比直流增益低 3 dB）。接上负载后通带增益从 1 降到 0.5，截止频率从 1000 rad/s 升到 2000 rad/s。

hints: 把电容以外的部分（U_s、R₁、R₂）化成戴维宁等效电路。
U_oc = U_s·R₂/(R₁ + R₂)，R_eq = R₁∥R₂；H(jω) = (R₂/(R₁ + R₂))·1/(1 + jωR_eqC)。
solution: **1. 戴维宁等效。** 断开 C：U_oc = U_s × 2/(2 + 2) = 0.5U_s；U_s 置零：R_eq = R₁∥R₂ = 1 kΩ。
**4. 解释。** 直流增益 H(0) = 0.5（−6.02 dB），截止处 20lg 0.3536 = −9.03 dB，比直流低 3 dB。截止频率要用**从储能元件看进去的等效电阻**计算，不能只用 R₁。

en.title: RC low-pass circuit with a load
statement: An RC low-pass circuit has a load R₂ across its output: R₁ = 2 kΩ, C = 0.5 µF, R₂ = 2 kΩ. The network function is H(jω) = U_o/U_s.
The source angular frequency is ω = 2000 rad/s. Find |H(jω)| and the phase of H(jω) at this frequency, and determine the circuit's cut-off frequency.

questions.explain: Thevenin equivalent: U_oc = U_s·R₂/(R₁ + R₂) = 0.5V_s, R_eq = R₁∥R₂ = 1 kΩ, H = 0.5/(1 + jωR_eqC) = 0.5/(1 + j1), |H| = 0.5/√2 ≈ 0.3536.

questions.ask: Cut-off frequency of this circuit, f_c = ? (ω_c = 2πf_c)
questions.explain: The resistance seen by the capacitor is R₁∥R₂ = 1 kΩ, so ω_c = 1/(R_eqC) = 2000 rad/s and f_c = ω_c/(2π) ≈ 318.3 Hz. At ω_c, |H| = 0.3536 is exactly 1/√2 of the low-frequency value 0.5 (3 dB below the DC gain). The load lowers the pass-band gain from 1 to 0.5 and raises the cut-off from 1000 to 2000 rad/s.

hints: Replace everything except the capacitor (U_s, R₁, R₂) with its Thevenin equivalent.
U_oc = U_s·R₂/(R₁ + R₂), R_eq = R₁∥R₂; H(jω) = (R₂/(R₁ + R₂))·1/(1 + jωR_eqC).
solution: **1. Thevenin equivalent.** Remove C: U_oc = U_s × 2/(2 + 2) = 0.5V_s; set U_s to zero: R_eq = R₁∥R₂ = 1 kΩ.
**2. Network function.** U_o = U_oc·(1/jωC)/(R_eq + 1/jωC), so H(jω) = 0.5/(1 + jωR_eqC) = 0.5/(1 + jω/ω_c) with ω_c = 1/(R_eqC) = 1/(10³ × 0.5 × 10⁻⁶) = **2000 rad/s**.
**3. At ω = 2000 rad/s.** This is exactly ω_c: H = 0.5/(1 + j) = 0.3536∠−45°, so |H| ≈ **0.3536** and the phase is **−45°**.

**4. Interpretation.** The DC gain is H(0) = 0.5 (−6.02 dB); at cut-off 20lg 0.3536 = −9.03 dB, 3 dB below DC. The cut-off frequency must be computed with the **resistance seen by the storage element**, not just R₁.
